sources.snippet: Solving FrozenLake with Reinforcement Learning 🤖 This project is a hands-on introduction to the world of Reinforcement Learning (RL) using the classic Q-learning algorithm. We train an agent to navigate the treacherous, slippery environment of the FrozenLake-v1 game from the Gymnasium library.
